name: Template: Adept

features.name: Class Advantages
features.text: Arcanum, Gift of Magic, Literacy, Scholar

descr: Adepts are experts, alchemists, artificers, bards, loremasters, and scholars—polymaths and tacticians who unravel mysteries and craft magic items. Their breadth of knowledge makes them highly sought after.

name: Template: Assassin

features.name: Class Advantages
features.text: Expeditious, Heightened Senses (Hearing), Observant, Read Emotions

features.name: Class Feats (Choose)
features.text: Death Strike, Lethal Exploit, Ranged Ambush, Shadow Walk

descr: Assassins are skilled killers and bounty hunters who excel in deception, ambush, and poisons. Quick and agile, they master stealth, ranged weapons, and concealable blades.

name: Template: Barbarian

features.name: Class Feats (Choose)
features.text: Berserk, Brawl, Feat of Strength, Grapple

descr: Barbarians are savage fighters known for brutal tactics and berserker rage. Far from mere bandits, they wield honed combat skills and fierce determination against formidable foes.

name: Template: Mage

features.name: Class Advantages
features.text: Arcanum, Gift of Magic, Magic Defense, Scholar

features.name: Class Feats (Choose)
features.text: Arcane Finesse, Dweomers, Intangible Threat, Path Mastery

descr: Mages study ancient grimoires and occult lore, specializing in Thaumaturgy, Elementalism, or Sorcery. Wizardry fuels their artificing, wards, and curses, enhanced by Arcane Finesse and Dweomercraft.

name: Template: Mystic

features.name: Class Advantages
features.text: Empathic, Gift of Magic, Intuitive, Magic Resistance (Lesser), Strong-Willed

features.name: Class Feats (Choose)
features.text: Iron Mind, Path Mastery ('Mysticism'), Premonition, Psychic Powers

descr: Mystics channel the path of Mysticism, wielding potent psychic and spiritual power. Often enigmatic travelers or contemplatives, they can learn other wizardry paths but risk spell failure outside their tradition.

name: Template: Rogue
descr: Rogues are independent-minded and cunning, thriving in urban shadows and criminal networks. They rely on stealth, deception, and opportunistic strikes to outmaneuver danger.

name: Template: Theurgist

features.name: Class Advantages
features.text: Gift of Magic, Magic Defense, Religion, Strong-Willed

features.name: Class Feats (Choose)
features.text: Divine Healing, Path Mastery, Spiritual Smite, Supernatural Intervention

descr: Theurgists are warrior ecclesiastics whose faith fuels divine magic. They follow Druidry or Hieraticism, invoking spiritual power to heal, restore, or unleash decay.

name: Template: Warrior

features.name: Class Feats (Choose)
features.text: Battle Savvy, Maneuvers, Stunning Reversal, Sunder Foe

descr: Warriors are skilled defenders of the realm, mastering weapons, maneuvers, and strategy. They are resilient, often resistant to magic, and serve as frontline protectors and leaders.
